notes: PEGZEUS is the entire accepted deliverable: an unmodified OpenZeppelin v5 ERC-20 with name PEGZEUS, symbol PEGZ and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 PEGZ (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) exactly once to msg.sender, the factory. There is no owner or admin role, no additional mint, burn, pause, blacklist or upgrade path, and no transfer fee: every transfer moves exactly the requested amount, so the launch's allocation, claim, seed and swap flows each move precisely what they say. The token makes no external calls and its runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. No application contracts accompany this launch, so contracts is empty; the token needs no constructor exemptions, initialization or helper contracts, and execute() and produce() are project context rather than token functions. All allocation is performed by the factory: economics.poolBps of the supply seeds the pool single-sided, economics.remainderTo receives the remainder and the swarm's share is handled by the launch system. No project contract reserves or receives any supply. The pool's opening price is derived by the deployer from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the total supply; pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
